description:
Cast Jump Scare by paying {W}, targeting Village Bell-Ringer.
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Village Bell-Ringer.
When the Village Bell-Ringer token enters, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Village Bell-Ringer token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.
